name: nested-type-separator-becomes-a-dot
why: typeof(T).FullName spells a nested type with '+', which is not in the subject grammar, so without this rule every nested message type is unusable. Note the cost, which is real and accepted: 'Acme.Orders+OrderCreated' and a top-level 'Acme.Orders.OrderCreated' collapse to the SAME subject and become indistinguishable. Refusing nested types outright was the alternative; DESIGN §3 chose the rewrite.
subject: Acme.Orders.OrderCreated
